{{Quote|Balmorra belongs to the Empire. The Barrager will only remove all doubt. You were very foolish to come here. Perhaps now you'll understand why.|[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Minax|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Darth Minax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]], who resided on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The theft of the [[Barrager]] design notes alerted her to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] interest in the Barrager, and she threatened to kill Dr. [[Carsiri]] for his involvement. She was killed by Republic and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces shortly thereafter.
